entries.title: V Rising
entries.definitive_edition: V Rising on Windows PC with Invaders of Oakveil

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: 1.1 / Invaders of Oakveil current PC release
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full-release route, has the best capture/settings and server flexibility, and received the same major Invaders of Oakveil content as PS5. The PS5 version is a valid console route but does not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam and update to the 1.1/Invaders of Oakveil build. Cosmetic DLC packs are optional and not required for gameplay completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Invaders of Oakveil is a major free update, not a separate game entry. Cosmetic packs such as Eternal Dominance are optional and not required for gameplay completeness.
